raw_text:
Here’s the full 12-week plan summary tailored to a 58-year-old male, 6 months post-MI, cleared for moderate intensity only. All work stays HR ≤ ~115 bpm (≤70% age‑predicted max), RPE 3–5 (≤6 on strength with 2–3 reps in reserve), no Valsalva, no maximal efforts or 1RM testing.

Global session template (every workout)
- Warm-up 8–10 min: easy cardio 5 min (RPE 2–3) + mobility (cat-camel, hip hinges, ankle rocks, shoulder rolls) + rehearsal sets
- Main work: per plan below
- Cool-down 8–10 min: light cardio to HR < 100, 4–6 breaths/min x 5 min, gentle stretches (calves, hip flexors, chest, lats)
- Monitoring: use HR + RPE + talk test; stop for chest pain/pressure, unusual SOB, dizziness, palpitations, radiating pain, excessive fatigue, or if BP becomes elevated; extend warm-up/cool-down in heat; exhale on exertion

Weekly frequency targets
- Aerobic: start 4–5 days/week; progress to 5–6 days/week and 220–300 min/wk by Weeks 10–12
- Strength: progress to 3 days/week (A/B/C) by Week 3; 14–20 working sets/session
- Mobility/balance: 3–5 days/week (10–12 min); brief daily is fine
- Steps/NEAT: build toward 8,000–10,000 steps/day by Weeks 8–12

Strength exercise pools (used across weeks; all sets at RPE 5–6, 2–3 reps in reserve, 60–120 s rest)
- Squat patterns: goblet box squat (progressing box height), step-up to low box, supported split squat; later optional front squat light
- Hinge patterns: kettlebell deadlift from blocks, cable pull-through, hip bridge; later trap-bar deadlift from blocks or high handles
- Upper pull: seated row, one-arm cable row, lat pulldown, straight-arm pulldown, prone Y/T or reverse fly
- Upper push: chest press machine, incline DB/machine press, cable chest press (neutral grip)
- Core/balance: Pallof press, dead bug, side plank (knees/feet), farmer carry (light), tandem/single-leg stance
- Accessories as needed: leg press, leg extension, ham curl, calf raise, face pull, external rotation

Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Reconditioning, technique, HR/RPE control
Goal by Week 4: 130–150+ aerobic min/wk; establish 2–3 strength days; learn breathing and form

Week 1
- Aerobic (4 days, 75–85 min total): walk 20–25 min (RPE 3), bike 20 min, elliptical 15–20 min
- Strength (2 days): full body circuit 2 rounds, 10–12 reps each, RPE 4–5; include leg press or goblet box squat, seated row, chest press machine, supported split squat, lat pulldown, light hinge, light curl-to-press, Pallof, calf raise
- Accessory add (6–8 extra sets): hip bridge, face pull, light carries
- Mobility/balance: 10–12 min x 3–5 days (tandem stance, weight shifts)

Week 2
- Aerobic (4–5 days, 90–110 min): 2× walks 25–30 min, 1× bike 20–25, 1× elliptical 20; optional easy 15–20
- Strength (2 days + 1 light technique day C): 2–3 rounds, 10–12 reps; Day C: goblet box squat, one-arm row, incline chest press, light KB deadlift from blocks, Pallof, calf raise
- Balance: add single-leg stand near support

Week 3
- Aerobic (5 days, 110–130 min): walks 30–35 min, bike 25–30, elliptical 20–25; optional pool 15–20
- Strength (3 days A/B/C; 3×10–12 where noted)
  - Day A: Goblet box squat; seated row; chest press; step-up; KB deadlift from blocks; Pallof; face pull
  - Day B: Hip bridge; lat pulldown; incline press; lateral step-down; straight-arm pulldown; curl-to-press; side plank
  - Day C: Supported split squat; one-arm cable row; cable chest press; hip abduction; reverse fly; dead bug; farmer carry

Week 4
- Aerobic (5 days, 130–150+ min): three 30–35 min steady sessions + two 25–30 min modality changes
- Strength (3 days): 3–4 sets of 10–12 on primary lifts if HR/RPE well controlled; option to slightly lower squat box or deadlift blocks if technique perfect

Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Volume build, moderate “upticks,” add squat/deadlift range
Goal: 170–200+ aerobic min/wk by Week 8; 3 strength days solid; begin gentle density

Week 5 (A/B/C)
- Aerobic (5 days, ~170–190 min):
  - Two 35–40 min walks steady
  - Bike 30 min with 3×2‑min upticks @ RPE 4–5 (equal easy), HR ≤ 115
  - Elliptical 25–30 min
  - Optional 20–25 min easy
- Strength
  - Day A: Goblet squat or leg press 4×8–12; seated row 4×8–12; chest press 3–4×8–12; step-up 3×8–10/side; hip bridge 3×12–15; Pallof 2–3×10–12/side
  - Day B: KB deadlift from low blocks 4×6–8; lat pulldown 4×8–12; incline press 3–4×8–12; lateral step-down 3×8–10/side; straight‑arm pulldown 2–3×12–15; side plank 2–3×20–30 s
  - Day C: Supported split squat 4×8–10/side; one‑arm cable row 3–4×10–12/side; cable chest press 3×10–12; hip abduction 2–3×12–15; reverse fly 2–3×12–15; farmer carry 3×20–30 m

Week 6 (A/B/C)
- Aerobic (5 days, 160–180+ min): two 40‑min walks; bike 30–35 min with 4×2‑min upticks; elliptical 30 min; optional 20–25 easy
- Strength: add 1 set to first 1–2 lifts if RPE ≤ 5, or micro-load +2–5 lb (upper), +5–10 lb (lower); rests 75–120 s

Week 7 (A/B/C)
- Aerobic (5 days): one 45‑min walk; one 35–40 min walk with 3×3‑min upticks; bike 30–35; elliptical 30; optional pool
- Strength: maintain volumes; slightly increase circuit density if HR allows; optional light sled push/pull 3×20–30 m keeping HR ≤ 115; add calf raises 3×12–15 and light wrist/forearm work

Week 8 (A/B/C; hold or deload-lite)
- Aerobic (5 days, 180–200 min): two 40–45 min steady; bike 35 min with 5×2‑min upticks; elliptical 30–35; optional easy 20–25
- Strength: keep loads/sets; precision on breathing/tempo; reduce total sets by ~15–20% this week if fatigue accumulates

Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Consolidation, higher aerobic volume (still moderate), optional trap-bar/goblet progressions
Goal: 180–220+ aerobic min/wk; by Weeks 10–12, 220–300 min/wk if weight loss is a priority; maintain 3 strength days

Week 9 (A/B/C; undulating reps: Day A 8–10, Day B 10–12, Day C 12–15)
- Aerobic (5–6 days, 200–240 min): long easy walk 50 min; mixed terrain 40–45 min (pace down on hills); bike 35–40; elliptical 30–35; optional pool 20–25
- Strength
  - Day A (8–10 reps): Goblet/front squat 4×8–10; seated row 4×8–10; chest press 3–4×8–10; KB deadlift from blocks 3–4×8–10; Pallof 3×10/side
  - Day B (10–12 reps): Step-up or split squat 4×10–12/side; lat pulldown 3–4×10–12; incline press 3–4×10–12; hip bridge 3×12; reverse fly 2–3×12–15; side plank 2–3×25–35 s
  - Day C (12–15 reps): One‑arm row 3–4×12–15/side; cable chest press or pec deck 3×12–15; hip abduction 3×12–15; leg extension 2–3×12–15; ham curl 2–3×12–15; farmer carry 3×30–40 m

Week 10 (A/B/C)
- Aerobic (6 days, 220–270 min): two steady walks 45–55; one walk 45–50 with 4×3‑min upticks; bike 40; optional easy 20–25
- Strength: repeat with micro-loads where RPE <5 or add 1 set to first compound of each day

Week 11 (A/B/C)
- Aerobic (6 days, 230–290 min): long easy 50–55; mixed 40–45 with gentle upticks; bike 35–40; elliptical 30–35; optional pool 20–25
- Strength: maintain; add chest‑supported row 2–3×10–12 on Day A if HR control is good; posture/thoracic mobility 8–10 min/block

Week 12 (A/B/C)
- Aerobic (6 days, 240–300 min): keep one 55–60 min long walk; one uptick session (5×3–4 min at RPE 4–5, equal easy); others steady; always cap HR ≤ 115
- Strength: consolidate; perfect technique and breathing; micro-progress 1 lower + 1 upper exercise if RPE allows

Compound lift integration checkpoints (squats/deadlifts)

- Weeks 3–6: 3–4 sets, 8–12 squats; 3–4 sets, 6–10 deadlifts; gradually lower box/blocks only if technique/HR perfect

Below is a conservative, cardio‑metabolic and strength‑endurance program designed for a 58‑year‑old male, six months post‑MI, cleared for moderate intensity only. It adheres to: HR ≤ ~115 bpm (≤70% age‑predicted max), RPE 3–5/10 (moderate), no Valsalva, no maximal efforts or 1RM testing, gradual progression, and strong emphasis on warm‑up, cool‑down, BP control, symptom monitoring, and recovery.

Global guidelines and precautions (apply every session)
- Monitoring:
  - Target intensity: HR ≤ 115 bpm and/or RPE 3–5/10. If on beta‑blockers, prioritize RPE and talk test (should be able to speak in full sentences).
  - Stop and refer if any chest pain/pressure, unusual shortness of breath, dizziness, palpitations, radiating pain, excessive fatigue, or BP > 180/100 during exercise.
  - Pre‑session: ask about overnight symptoms, meds adherence, hydration, last meal.
  - Check resting HR/BP when feasible early in the program.
- Breathing and tempo:
  - No Valsalva; exhale on exertion, inhale on return. Use controlled tempos (2–3 s concentric, 2–3 s eccentric), avoid grinding reps.
- Progression:
  - Progress volume first, then modest intensity within HR/RPE limits.
  - Strength loads guided by RPE 4–6/10 for sets (2–3 reps in reserve), never to failure.
- Session structure (most days):
  - 8–10 min warm‑up: easy cardio + mobility + rehearsal sets.
  - Main work: aerobic and/or resistance per plan.
  - 8–10 min cool‑down: light cardio to HR < 100 bpm, breathing drills, stretching.
- Frequency targets by Phase:
  - Aerobic: 4–5 days/week.
  - Resistance: 2–3 days/week, non‑consecutive when possible.
  - Flexibility/balance: 3–5 days/week, brief daily is fine.
- Hydration and temperature:
  - Hydrate before/during/after; avoid very hot environments; extend warm‑ups/cool‑downs in heat.
- Meds timing:
  - If on beta‑blockers/nitrates, allow longer warm‑up and gradual ramps; carry prescribed nitro if applicable.
- Recovery:
  - 7–8 h sleep, light walking on off days, no alcohol near sessions, manage stress with breathing (4–6 breaths/min for 5 min).

Programme overview
- Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Re‑conditioning and technique. Build tolerance, establish HR/RPE control, foundational strength/endurance, balance.
- Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Progressive volume and mixed modalities. Slightly longer aerobic bouts, introduce interval‑style “aerobic conditioning” within moderate limits, increase exercise variety.
- Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Consolidation and independence. Maintain safe intensity, add gentle undulating volume, optional light circuits, prepare for long‑term routine.

Intensity references
- Aerobic steady: RPE 3–4, HR typically 95–110 bpm; talk test easy.
- Aerobic “upticks”: RPE 4–5, HR ≤ 115 bpm; talk test comfortable but slightly breathier.
- Resistance load: select weight that reaches prescribed reps at RPE 4–6, leaving 2–3 reps in reserve, with perfect form and steady breathing.

Week-by-week plan

Phase 1: Weeks 1–4 (Re‑conditioning and technique)
Goal: 150+ min/week of moderate aerobic by week 4; 2× full‑body strength sessions; balance and mobility habit.

Week 1
- Aerobic (4 days):
  - Day A: Treadmill walk 20 min @ RPE 3, 0–2% incline as tolerated. HR check at 5, 10, 15 min.
  - Day B: Recumbent bike 20 min @ RPE 3 (60–70 rpm), low resistance.
  - Day C: Treadmill or outdoor walk 25 min @ RPE 3.
  - Day D: Elliptical 15–20 min @ RPE 3 (short cranks/low resistance). If unfamiliar, start 10–12 min and build.
- Resistance (2 days, non‑consecutive; e.g., Mon/Thu):
  - Warm‑up: 8 min easy cardio + dynamic mobility (ankle circles, hip hinges, shoulder rolls); 1–2 rehearsal sets with very light load.
  - Circuit (2 rounds, 10–12 reps each, RPE 4–5, 60–75 s rest between exercises):
    - Leg press (or sit‑to‑stand from a high box if needed)
    - Seated cable row
    - Chest press machine (neutral grip if available)
    - Supported split squat or heel‑elevated bodyweight split squat (8–10 reps/side)
    - Lat pulldown (wide or neutral grip)
    - Cable or machine hip hinge (RDL pattern with light dumbbells if proficient)
    - Standing DB curl to press (very light; 8–10 reps; exhale on press)
    - Pallof press (anti‑rotation) 10–12 reps/side
    - Seated calf raise 12–15 reps
  - Finish: 5–8 min cool‑down + gentle stretches (calves, hip flexors, chest).
- Flexibility/balance (3–5 days, 10–12 min):
  - Ankle dorsiflexion rocks, hamstring stretch with strap, chest doorway stretch, thoracic open books.
  - Balance: tandem stance 3×30–45 s/side, eyes open; weight shifts.

Week 2
- Aerobic (4–5 days, build to 90–110 total min):
  - Two walks 25–30 min @ RPE 3–4.
  - One bike 20–25 min @ RPE 3.
  - One elliptical 20 min @ RPE 3.
  - Optional fifth easy walk 15–20 min if fresh.
- Resistance (2 days):
  - Same exercise menu; 2–3 rounds depending on HR/RPE, 10–12 reps.
  - Add one core endurance: side plank from knees 2×20–30 s/side (steady breathing).
- Balance/mobility: continue; add single‑leg stand near support 3×20 s/side.

Week 3
- Aerobic (5 days, 110–130 min total):
  - Two steady walks 30–35 min @ RPE 3–4.
  - Bike 25–30 min @ RPE 3–4.
  - Elliptical 20–25 min @ RPE 3–4.
  - Optional pool walk or easy lane swim 15–20 min if available (avoid breath‑holding; bilateral easy breathing).
- Resistance (2–3 days; if 3rd day, make it lighter):
  - Progress to 3 rounds for most exercises at 10–12 reps, RPE 4–5.
  - Swap in variations to reduce monotony:
    - Goblet box squat instead of leg press (high box to control depth).
    - One‑arm cable row.
    - Incline machine chest press.
    - Hip hinge with dowel drill + light KB deadlift from blocks.
  - Add scapular control: prone Y/T (on incline bench) 2×10 each with very light load or bodyweight.
- Flexibility/balance: maintain; add heel‑toe walk 2×10 m.

Week 4
- Aerobic (5 days, 130–150+ min total):
  - Three steady sessions 30–35 min @ RPE 3–4.
  - Two modality changes (bike/elliptical/pool) 25–30 min @ RPE 3–4.
- Resistance (2 days):
  - 3 rounds, 10–15 reps, RPE 4–6. Keep rest 60–90 s; ensure HR ≤ 115.
  - Add step‑up to low box 2–3×8–10/side in place of split squat if balance acceptable.
- End of Phase check:
  - He should tolerate 30–35 min continuous moderate cardio, and 18–24 total sets/session of light‑moderate strength without symptoms. If any issues, hold progression and consult MD.

Phase 2: Weeks 5–8 (Progressive volume and mixed modalities)
Goal: Build to 170–200 min/wk aerobic, introduce gentle moderate “upticks” while staying ≤70% HRmax, keep strength at 2–3 days, emphasize posture, hips, and scapular stability.

Week 5
- Aerobic (5 days):
  - Two steady walks 35–40 min @ RPE 3–4.
  - One bike 30 min with 3×2‑min slight upticks @ RPE 4–5 (HR remains ≤115), 2‑min easy between.
  - One elliptical 25–30 min steady.
  - Optional fifth: pool or outdoor walk 20–25 min easy.
- Resistance (2–3 days):
  - Full‑body A and B (alternate):
    - Day A (3 rounds, 10–12 reps):
      - Leg press or goblet squat to box
      - Seated row (neutral)
      - Chest press machine
      - Hip hinge: KB deadlift from blocks
      - Lateral step‑down to low step 8–10/side
      - Lat pulldown
      - Pallof press 12/side
      - Farmer carry light DBs 3×20–30 m (nasal breathing, relaxed grip)
    - Day B (3 rounds, 10–12 reps):
      - Split squat or step‑up 8–10/side
      - One‑arm cable row 10–12/side
      - Incline DB press (light)
      - Cable hip abduction 12–15/side
      - Reverse fly on cables 12–15
      - Seated calf raise 12–15
      - Dead bug 2–3×8–10/side (slow, exhale on reach)
- Balance/mobility: add semi‑tandem to single‑leg balance progressions, 3×30–45 s.

Week 6
- Aerobic (5 days, 160–180 min total):
  - Two 40‑min walks @ RPE 3–4.
  - Bike 30–35 min with 4×2‑min upticks @ RPE 4–5, 2‑min easy.
  - Elliptical 30 min steady.
  - Optional fifth: 20–25 min easy recovery walk.
- Resistance (2–3 days):
  - Keep volumes; if RPE <4, increase reps to 12–15 or add a set to larger lifts while monitoring HR.
  - Add scapular depression drill: straight‑arm pulldown 2×12–15.
- Technique emphasis: posture, long exhale on exertions, avoid breath stacking.

Week 7
- Aerobic (5 days):
  - One longer walk 45 min @ RPE 3–4.
  - One walk 35–40 min with 3×3‑min upticks @ RPE 4–5 (talk test still passes).
  - Bike 30–35 min steady.
  - Elliptical 30 min steady.
  - Optional fifth: pool 20–25 min.
- Resistance (2 days):
  - Slight circuit density increase: keep same loads but reduce rest to ~60 s if HR allows.
  - Insert gentle sled push/pull (very light) 3×20–30 m as conditioning finisher on one day, keeping HR ≤ 115.
- Balance/mobility: continue; add step‑over cone drills 2×10 each direction.

Week 8
- Aerobic (5 days, 180–200 min total):
  - Two steady 40–45 min walks.
  - Bike 35 min with 5×2‑min upticks @ RPE 4–5, 2‑min easy.
  - Elliptical 30–35 min.
  - Optional fifth easy day 20–25 min.
- Resistance (2–3 days):
  - Maintain volumes; if well‑tolerated, progress some movements to 3–4 sets of 10–12 at RPE 5–6.
- End of Phase check:
  - Should tolerate 40–45 min moderate cardio, occasional brief RPE 5 segments with HR ≤ 115, and 20–28 total strength sets without symptoms.

Phase 3: Weeks 9–12 (Consolidation and independence)
Goal: Solidify aerobic base 180–220 min/wk, maintain strength and mobility, introduce light circuits or intervals that remain strictly moderate, reinforce self‑monitoring.

Week 9
- Aerobic (5 days):
  - One “long easy” walk 50 min @ RPE 3–4.
  - One mixed‑terrain walk 40–45 min, keep HR in range (adjust pace on hills).
  - Bike 35–40 min steady @ RPE 3–4.
  - Elliptical 30–35 min steady.
  - Optional pool 20–25 min recovery.
- Resistance (2–3 days; introduce light circuit day):
  - Day A (Strength emphasis; 3–4 sets, 8–12 reps, RPE 5):
    - Goblet box squat
    - Seated row
    - Chest press machine
    - KB deadlift from blocks
    - Step‑up to low box
    - Lat pulldown
    - Pallof press
  - Day B (Light circuit; 2–3 rounds, 10–12 reps, 45–60 s rest, HR ≤ 115):
    - Sled push/pull light 20 m
    - Incline DB press
    - One‑arm cable row
    - Cable hip abduction
    - Reverse fly
    - Dead bug
    - Farmer carry 20–30 m
  - Optional Day C: mobility + core + calves + light accessories only.

Week 10
- Aerobic (5 days, maintain 180–200+ min):
  - One walk with 4×3‑min RPE 4–5 segments separated by 3 min easy; total 40–45 min.
  - Two steady walks 40–45 and 30–35 min.
  - Bike 35–40 min steady or 4×2‑min upticks.
  - Optional fifth easy 20–25 min.
- Resistance (2 days):
  - Keep loads; aim for technical quality, smooth breathing, RPE 5–6 tops.
  - Add gentle rotary stability: bird dog 2–3×8/side (5‑s holds).

Week 11
- Aerobic (5 days):
  - Long easy 50–55 min @ RPE 3–4.
  - Mixed walk 40–45 min with small upticks as terrain dictates, cap HR.
  - Bike 35–40 min steady.
  - Elliptical 30–35 min steady.
  - Optional pool 20–25 min recovery.
- Resistance (2–3 days):
  - Maintain or very small progression (e.g., +2 reps/set on primary moves) only if HR and RPE remain in range.
  - Add gentle thoracic mobility and posture block 8–10 min pre‑ or post‑session.

Week 12
- Aerobic (5 days, 190–220 min total):
  - Choose preferred modalities; keep one long 50–55 min session, one with mild upticks; others steady.
- Resistance (2 days):
  - Repeat Week 11; emphasize sustainability and confidence with breathing and self‑monitoring.
- End of Phase review and transition plan:
  - Confirm he can self‑regulate to RPE 3–5, knows stop symptoms, and can structure 5 cardio + 2 strength days safely.
  - Set longer‑term goals: 200–250 min/wk aerobic, maintain 2–3 strength days, continue balance/mobility.

Warm‑up and cool‑down template (all sessions)
- Warm‑up (8–10 min):
  - 5 min easy cardio (RPE 2–3).
  - Mobility: cat‑camel 6–8 reps, hip hinges x10, ankle rocks x10/side, shoulder CARs x5/side.
  - Rehearsal set for first two lifts with very light weight.
- Cool‑down (8–10 min):
  - 5 min light cardio to bring HR < 100.
  - Breathing: 4‑second inhale, 6‑second exhale x 8–10 cycles.
  - Stretch: calves, quads/hip flexors, pec minor doorway, lats, 20–30 s each.

Nutrition and lifestyle notes (general fitness/cardiac‑friendly; confirm with MD/dietitian)
- Heart‑healthy pattern (e.g., Mediterranean‑style):
  - Emphasize vegetables, fruits, legumes, whole grains, nuts, seeds.
  - Lean proteins: fish 2–3×/wk, poultry, low‑fat dairy; plant proteins often.
  - Fats: olive oil, avocado; minimize trans fats and excess saturated fat.
  - Sodium: moderate; read labels; target <2,300 mg/day unless otherwise directed.
  - Hydration: 30–35 ml/kg/day as baseline; add during exercise.
  - Pre‑exercise: small carb + protein snack 60–90 min pre (e.g., yogurt + fruit).
  - Post‑exercise: balanced meal within 2–3 h; if delayed, a snack with carbs+protein.
  - Alcohol: minimize/avoid, especially around training; align with cardiology guidance.
- Weight and lipids:
  - If weight loss is desired and approved, aim for modest 300–500 kcal/day deficit; prioritize protein ~1.0–1.2 g/kg/day unless contraindicated.

Safety and communication
- Keep nitroglycerin accessible if prescribed; know his MD’s return‑to‑care instructions.
- Document RPE/HR and any symptoms each session.
- Regressions always available (reduce range, lower load, shift to machine support).
- When in doubt, extend warm‑up, lower intensity, or substitute with recumbent modalities.

Equipment substitutions (if needed)
- Leg press ↔ goblet box squat.
- Chest press machine ↔ push‑up to elevated bar/wall.
- Seated row ↔ chest‑supported row or resistance band row.
- Lat pulldown ↔ assisted pull‑down machine or high band pulldown.
- Elliptical ↔ upright or recumbent bike; treadmill ↔ indoor track.

This structure keeps intensity comfortably moderate, builds aerobic volume safely, maintains whole‑body strength and balance, and emphasizes breathing and symptom monitoring appropriate for a client post‑MI. Adjust week to week based on his RPE/HR responses and cardiologist recommendations.

Weekly structure and targets

Sample 1‑week menu (mix and match)
- Breakfasts:
  - Oats cooked with low‑fat milk, topped with walnuts, blueberries, and cinnamon; side of kefir or yogurt.
  - Veggie omelet (2 eggs + extra whites) with spinach, tomatoes, mushrooms; 1 slice whole‑grain toast with olive oil or avocado; fruit.

Pre/post‑workout fueling (moderate‑intensity sessions)

- Track BP at home (morning/evening a few days each week) and note how sodium days affect readings.

Goal by Week 4: 130–150+ aerobic min/wk; establish 2–3 strength days; learn breathing and form

Week 1
- Aerobic (4 days, 75–85 min total): walk 20–25 min (RPE 3), bike 20 min, elliptical 15–20 min
- Strength (2 days): full body circuit 2 rounds, 10–12 reps each, RPE 4–5; include leg press or goblet box squat, seated row, chest press machine, supported split squat, lat pulldown, light hinge, light curl-to-press, Pallof, calf raise
- Accessory add (6–8 extra sets): hip bridge, face pull, light carries
- Mobility/balance: 10–12 min x 3–5 days (tandem stance, weight shifts)

Week 2
- Aerobic (4–5 days, 90–110 min): 2× walks 25–30 min, 1× bike 20–25, 1× elliptical 20; optional easy 15–20
- Strength (2 days + 1 light technique day C): 2–3 rounds, 10–12 reps; Day C: goblet box squat, one-arm row, incline chest press, light KB deadlift from blocks, Pallof, calf raise
- Balance: add single-leg stand near support

Week 3
- Aerobic (5 days, 110–130 min): walks 30–35 min, bike 25–30, elliptical 20–25; optional pool 15–20
- Strength (3 days A/B/C; 3×10–12 where noted)
  - Day A: Goblet box squat; seated row; chest press; step-up; KB deadlift from blocks; Pallof; face pull
  - Day B: Hip bridge; lat pulldown; incline press; lateral step-down; straight-arm pulldown; curl-to-press; side plank
  - Day C: Supported split squat; one-arm cable row; cable chest press; hip abduction; reverse fly; dead bug; farmer carry

Week 4
- Aerobic (5 days, 130–150+ min): three 30–35 min steady sessions + two 25–30 min modality changes
- Strength (3 days): 3–4 sets of 10–12 on primary lifts if HR/RPE well controlled; option to slightly lower squat box or deadlift blocks if technique perfect

Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Volume build, moderate “upticks,” add squat/deadlift range
Goal: 170–200+ aerobic min/wk by Week 8; 3 strength days solid; begin gentle density

Week 5 (A/B/C)
- Aerobic (5 days, ~170–190 min):
  - Two 35–40 min walks steady
  - Bike 30 min with 3×2‑min upticks @ RPE 4–5 (equal easy), HR ≤ 115
  - Elliptical 25–30 min
  - Optional 20–25 min easy
- Strength
  - Day A: Goblet squat or leg press 4×8–12; seated row 4×8–12; chest press 3–4×8–12; step-up 3×8–10/side; hip bridge 3×12–15; Pallof 2–3×10–12/side
  - Day B: KB deadlift from low blocks 4×6–8; lat pulldown 4×8–12; incline press 3–4×8–12; lateral step-down 3×8–10/side; straight‑arm pulldown 2–3×12–15; side plank 2–3×20–30 s
  - Day C: Supported split squat 4×8–10/side; one‑arm cable row 3–4×10–12/side; cable chest press 3×10–12; hip abduction 2–3×12–15; reverse fly 2–3×12–15; farmer carry 3×20–30 m

Week 6 (A/B/C)
- Aerobic (5 days, 160–180+ min): two 40‑min walks; bike 30–35 min with 4×2‑min upticks; elliptical 30 min; optional 20–25 easy
- Strength: add 1 set to first 1–2 lifts if RPE ≤ 5, or micro-load +2–5 lb (upper), +5–10 lb (lower); rests 75–120 s

Week 7 (A/B/C)
- Aerobic (5 days): one 45‑min walk; one 35–40 min walk with 3×3‑min upticks; bike 30–35; elliptical 30; optional pool
- Strength: maintain volumes; slightly increase circuit density if HR allows; optional light sled push/pull 3×20–30 m keeping HR ≤ 115; add calf raises 3×12–15 and light wrist/forearm work

Week 8 (A/B/C; hold or deload-lite)
- Aerobic (5 days, 180–200 min): two 40–45 min steady; bike 35 min with 5×2‑min upticks; elliptical 30–35; optional easy 20–25
- Strength: keep loads/sets; precision on breathing/tempo; reduce total sets by ~15–20% this week if fatigue accumulates

Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Consolidation, higher aerobic volume (still moderate), optional trap-bar/goblet progressions
Goal: 180–220+ aerobic min/wk; by Weeks 10–12, 220–300 min/wk if weight loss is a priority; maintain 3 strength days

Week 9 (A/B/C; undulating reps: Day A 8–10, Day B 10–12, Day C 12–15)
- Aerobic (5–6 days, 200–240 min): long easy walk 50 min; mixed terrain 40–45 min (pace down on hills); bike 35–40; elliptical 30–35; optional pool 20–25
- Strength
  - Day A (8–10 reps): Goblet/front squat 4×8–10; seated row 4×8–10; chest press 3–4×8–10; KB deadlift from blocks 3–4×8–10; Pallof 3×10/side
  - Day B (10–12 reps): Step-up or split squat 4×10–12/side; lat pulldown 3–4×10–12; incline press 3–4×10–12; hip bridge 3×12; reverse fly 2–3×12–15; side plank 2–3×25–35 s
  - Day C (12–15 reps): One‑arm row 3–4×12–15/side; cable chest press or pec deck 3×12–15; hip abduction 3×12–15; leg extension 2–3×12–15; ham curl 2–3×12–15; farmer carry 3×30–40 m

Week 10 (A/B/C)
- Aerobic (6 days, 220–270 min): two steady walks 45–55; one walk 45–50 with 4×3‑min upticks; bike 40; optional easy 20–25
- Strength: repeat with micro-loads where RPE <5 or add 1 set to first compound of each day

Week 11 (A/B/C)
- Aerobic (6 days, 230–290 min): long easy 50–55; mixed 40–45 with gentle upticks; bike 35–40; elliptical 30–35; optional pool 20–25
- Strength: maintain; add chest‑supported row 2–3×10–12 on Day A if HR control is good; posture/thoracic mobility 8–10 min/block

Week 12 (A/B/C)
- Aerobic (6 days, 240–300 min): keep one 55–60 min long walk; one uptick session (5×3–4 min at RPE 4–5, equal easy); others steady; always cap HR ≤ 115
- Strength: consolidate; perfect technique and breathing; micro-progress 1 lower + 1 upper exercise if RPE allows

Compound lift integration checkpoints (squats/deadlifts)
- Start Weeks 1–2: goblet box squat + KB deadlift from high blocks, 2–3×8–10 (RPE 4–5)
- Weeks 3–6: 3–4 sets, 8–12 squats; 3–4 sets, 6–10 deadlifts; gradually lower box/blocks only if technique/HR perfect
- Weeks 9–12 optional: goblet/front squat 4×6–10; trap‑bar deadlift from blocks/high handles 4×5–8 (RPE 5–6). No conventional heavy barbell lifts; no grinders; no Valsalva

Cardio for weight loss (always moderate)
- Build to 220–300 min/wk by Weeks 10–12 via longer steady sessions + moderate “upticks” (2–5 min at RPE 4–5 with equal or longer easy)
- Prefer walking, bike, elliptical, pool; slight incline/resistance to nudge density; strict HR/RPE/talk-test caps
- Steps/NEAT: ramp toward 8–10k/day by Weeks 8–12

Assessments (submax only; no time trial racing)
- Week 1 baseline: 6-minute walk test; 30-min submax distance (HR ≤ 115, RPE ≤ 5); note symptoms/HR/RPE
- Weeks 6 and 12: repeat 6MWT and 30-min test; optional submax 5 km brisk walk rehearsal (cap HR/RPE) to compare total time at the same caps
- Strength tracking: load or rep increases at same RPE/HR; improved balance times; smoother breathing

Nutrition (cardiac-focused; supports weight loss and strength)
- Pattern: Mediterranean/DASH; vegetables/fruits ≥5 servings/day; whole grains 3–6 servings; legumes ≥4×/week; fish 2–3×/week (one oily); nuts/seeds 1 oz/day; olive oil as main fat
- Sodium: <2,300 mg/day (1,500–2,000 mg if advised)
- Protein: 1.0–1.2 g/kg/day, 25–35 g/meal; post-strength protein within 2 h
- Calories: 300–500 kcal/day deficit if weight loss desired (0.25–0.5 kg/week); high-fiber carbs; limit added sugars and alcohol
- Hydration: 30–35 ml/kg/day; pre/post exercise fluids; align electrolytes with BP guidance
- Evidence-based add-ons (if approved): psyllium or ground flax (LDL), plant sterols, omega‑3s via fish or MD-approved supplement

Weekly layout example (with 3 strength days and higher aerobic volume)
- Mon: Strength A + 20–25 min easy walk
- Tue: 45–55 min steady walk
- Wed: Strength B + 30–40 min bike (steady)
- Thu: 45–50 min walk with moderate upticks (HR ≤ 115)
- Fri: Strength C + 30–35 min elliptical (steady)

Safety reminders
- Strictly avoid Valsalva; exhale on exertions; stop sets early if form or breathing deteriorates
- Keep nitroglycerin accessible if prescribed; know stop symptoms and referral thresholds
- If HR exceeds cap or symptoms appear, reduce load/intensity, lengthen rests, or switch to supported machines; document HR/RPE and symptoms each session

This summary delivers a clear 12-week path: progressive moderate aerobic volume for weight loss, three-day strength with safe squat/deadlift patterns, and cardiac-appropriate nutrition and assessments—while staying within post-MI safety limits.
